question: Our outpatient imaging denials spiked in Ohio last quarter. Why, and what is it costing us?

governed_answer.root_cause: UM-RAD-2026 policy effective 2026-04-01 requires 120-day prior auth notice per MP-RAD-114 §4.2 and contract §7.3. Health System 14 (HS-14) was omitted from notification cohort NC-2026-03, resulting in CARC-197 denials for all HS-14 outpatient imaging.
governed_answer.accountable_party: Plan (ACME Commercial PPO - Ohio) - notification gap
governed_answer.remediation: Add HS-14 TINs to notification cohort and reprocess denied claims under appeal.
